title: Need some help here
body:
Hi, I’m running iOS (15.2.1) and iPhone 13. My Google calendar app is of the newest version according to AppStore. Today, I realised I can no longer click and drag to reschedule an existing event from my iOS Google calendar app. Whenever I do that, the event bounces back to the original schedule after a few seconds or after some scrolling. I have attempted logging out and in of my account, as well as reinstalling the app, to no avail. I can drag and drop to reschedule events without issue from the web version of Google calendar, or from my iPad. If I click and drag an event from my iPad or from the web version, the change will be reflected immediately on all my devices. But when I do this from the iPhone app, it not only doesn’t reflect on the other devices, the event then bounces back to its original slot after a short while (or after i click into the event to view the details). 

In short, clicking and dragging doesn’t give the desired effect on iOS app any longer but still works on iPadOS and web version of Google calendar. I wish to add that manually keying in the new date and time for an event still works, but not dragging and dropping.

Kindly rectify the issue in the next update. Thanks a lot guys!
